capabilities: Resize diagrams by dragging a corner handle
Align diagrams left, center or right from the context menu
Persist size and alignment as Mermaid comments inside the block
Store independent sizes for desktop and mobile
Clear stored sizes per device from the context menu
extras: Works only in reading view; the handle and alignment menu are unavailable in Live Preview and embeds, and on mobile a long press does not always fire the context menu.
motivation: The author wanted diagram size changes to persist across re-renders and sync, unlike zoom plugins where the diagram resets when the note is reopened.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams at whatever size Mermaid computes, with no resize handle like images get, and zoom plugins do not remember adjustments between sessions.
summary: Mermaid diagram resizer that adds a drag handle and right-click alignment, persisting each diagram's size as a Mermaid comment inside the block.
